decisions.what: EN: 10 k pull-up to 3V3 + 1 uF to GND (RC delay), RESET button EN to GND; never leave EN floating
decisions.why: power-up must precede CHIP_EN release; recommended R = 10 k, C = 1 uF
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf), s3.2 Table 3-1 note and s9 Peripheral Schematics notes

decisions.what: GPIO9 = BOOT: button to GND, 10 k external pull-up (internal weak pull-up exists)
decisions.why: GPIO9 = 0 at reset selects joint download boot (USB-Serial-JTAG or UART); default 1 = SPI boot
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf), s4.1 Table 4-3 and Table 4-1

decisions.what: GPIO8 pulled up 10 k; nothing on GPIO8 that can pull it low at reset
decisions.why: download boot requires GPIO8 = 1; GPIO8 also gates UART0 ROM log; default is floating
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf), Table 4-1 (GPIO8 floating), Table 4-3

decisions.why: Espressif: GPIO2 does not select boot mode but 'it is recommended to pull this pin up due to glitches'; default floating
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf), Table 4-3 note 2

decisions.what: status LED on GPIO10 (not a strap pin), VBAT sense on GPIO3 = ADC1_CH3
decisions.why: strap pins are GPIO2/8/9; ADC1 channels are GPIO0-4 and ADC1 is the factory-calibrated converter; GPIO2 is ADC1 but a strap
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf), Table 3-1 pin functions; s5 ADC1 factory-calibrated

decisions.what: 3V3 decoupling: 10 uF + 0.1 uF at module pin 3
decisions.why: peripheral schematic C1 10 uF / C2 0.1 uF; guideline 'add a 10 uF capacitor before the power trace enters the chip'
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf) s9 Figure 9-1; ESP32-C3 Hardware Design Guidelines, PCB layout design (https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-hardware-design-guidelines/en/latest/esp32c3/pcb-layout-design.html)

decisions.what: antenna at the board edge, ideally overhanging; no copper/parts under the antenna area on any layer; if not overhanging, cut the base board on both sides and below the antenna; never centre the module with a hollowed keep-out
decisions.why: base board copper detunes the PCB antenna
decisions.source: ESP32-C3 Hardware Design Guidelines, PCB layout design (https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-hardware-design-guidelines/en/latest/esp32c3/pcb-layout-design.html) (module placement); ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf) Figure 11-1 'Antenna Area'

decisions.what: EPAD soldered to GND with vias (optional but improves thermal)
decisions.why: datasheet: not a must, optimises thermal; avoid excess paste (lifts module)
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf) s9 notes

decisions.why: VDD33 recommended range and 'current delivered by external power supply 0.5 A min'
decisions.source: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U Datasheet v2.2 (parts/U1_esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-c3-mini-1_datasheet_en.pdf) s6.2 Table (VDD33 3.0/3.3/3.6 V; IVDD 0.5 A)

layout_notes: antenna area at an edge with no copper under it on either layer (keep-out rect follows Figure 11-1 Antenna Area)
15 mm clearance around the antenna inside the final housing (product-level)
USB pair parallel, equal length, short
errata: GPIO8 floats by default: an LED or load pulling it low blocks USB download boot
GPIO4-7 are JTAG pins when the pad-JTAG eFuse is set (default is USB JTAG, so free)
